report_name: CIRO Reaches $8.3M Settlement for 2025 Data Breach Affecting 750k

threat_actors.name: CIRO Data Breach Actor
threat_actors.description: The unidentified threat actor responsible for the 2025 phishing attack and subsequent data breach against the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO).
threat_actors.goals: Theft of personal and financial data of approximately 750,000 Canadians.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The data breach was initiated by a successful phishing attack against an employee of the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO).

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker used credentials obtained from a phishing attack to gain access to the CIRO network and internal data.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The attacker accessed and collected sensitive personal and financial information from databases or file shares within CIRO's network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exfiltrated approximately 750,000 records, including Social Insurance Numbers and investment account details, from CIRO's network to an external, attacker-controlled server.

identities.name: Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO)
identities.description: Canada's national investment regulator, which suffered a data breach originating from a phishing attack, exposing the data of 750,000 individuals.

identities.name: Canadian Investors and Employees
identities.description: A group of approximately 750,000 Canadians, including retail investors and employees of CIRO member firms, whose personal and financial data was compromised in the breach.

infrastructure.name: Attacker-controlled Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: An external server controlled by the attacker to which 750,000 records from CIRO's network were exfiltrated.
